collection:flags.title: Flags
collection:flags.title__note: Screen title for the flag collection.
collection:countries.title: Countries
collection:countries.title__note: Screen title for the country collection.
collection:progress__note: Collection progress. Reads as a count, never a percentage — a percentage hides how close the next one is.
collection:progress.label: Progress
collection:progress.label__note: Left of the collection progress bar; the count renders on the right, so this says WHAT is being counted rather than repeating the number. Must NOT be 'Collected' — that is already the name of a filter chip on the same screen, and two controls sharing an accessible name is ambiguous to a screen reader. Max 14 characters.
collection:locked__note: Accessibility label suffix for a tile the user has not mastered. Never 'locked' in the UI — nothing is being withheld.
collection:collected__note: Accessibility label suffix for a mastered tile.
collection:filter.collected__note: Filter chip showing only mastered tiles.
collection:filter.missing__note: Filter chip showing only unmastered tiles. Phrased as an invitation, never as a failure.
collection:filter.favourites__note: Filter chip showing only countries the user has starred. Max 12 characters.
collection:favourite__note: Accessibility label suffix for a starred tile.
collection:favourites.none.title: Nothing starred yet
collection:favourites.none.title__note: Empty state when the starred filter matches nothing.
collection:favourites.none.body: Open any country and tap the star to keep it here.
collection:favourites.none.body__note: Empty state body. Names the exact next step, which is a star and not a lesson.
collection:empty.title: Nothing here yet
collection:empty.title__note: Empty state when a filter matches nothing.
collection:empty.body: Finish a lesson and your first one appears here.
collection:empty.body__note: Empty state body. Always names the next step.
collection:empty.action__note: Button on the empty collection state.
collection:search__note: Placeholder in the collection search field.
collection:search.none.title: No match for “{query}”
collection:search.none.title__note: Search empty state. {query} is what the user typed.
collection:search.none.body: Check the spelling, or browse by continent.
collection:search.none.body__note: Search empty state body. Offers a way onward rather than a dead end.
